events.description: The Messenger — amber sphere at TealPillar base. The past visiting the present.
The past sends messengers to the present.
Gentle — recovery tenderness. New skin over a healed place.

summary: Day 15 — a gentle day. Placed the Messenger, an amber sphere at the TealPillar's base, linking past and present. The two pillars face each other with a shared object between them. The past sends messengers.
